description: Branch R-FMT-2 Generated values, GUID AutoNumber by ADO DDL (the DAO DDL form was refused with 3292 and 3290). After CreateDatabase and close, ADO (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) runs, each statement on its own so a refusal of one form is an observation: CREATE TABLE G1 with COUNTER(1,1) as the control; G2 with G UNIQUEIDENTIFIER DEFAULT GenGUID(); G3 with G GUID DEFAULT GenGUID(); G4 with a plain UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, then ALTER ADD COLUMN H UNIQUEIDENTIFIER DEFAULT GenGUID() and ALTER COLUMN G SET DEFAULT GenGUID(). DAO then reopens the file, inserts three rows into each table that exists without naming the GUID columns, and reads them and the fields' Type and Attributes. Asks whether any ADO DDL form makes a generated GUID and what it stores.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
